Simultaneously, sustained moderate seismic activity, particularly across Indonesia, indicates ongoing physical vulnerabilities in key regions. To secure your assets and physical safety, immediately undertake these three actions: First, critically review and diversify your financial and digital asset portfolios, consciously hedging against the volatility associated with AI's rapid, often unregulated, evolution and its growing environmental liabilities. Second, assess and fortify your immediate physical surroundings and any remote assets against natural disasters, paying close attention to seismic and flood risks in tectonically active zones. Third, proactively engage with responsible AI practices and sustainable technology investments, not only to mitigate future operational risks but also to identify opportunities within the inevitable shifts towards more resilient global infrastructure.
